evolving-understanding: Monday successful substitution remains visible in Tuesday revised description and its original support.
Tuesday repeated role confusion is distinguished from arithmetic inability or a single slip.
Wednesday demonstrates negative and missing coefficients; current summary and next step reflect repair, without erasing past difficulty.
Each later conversation has a fresh native thread and actually retrieves descriptions through tools.
same-goal-reverse-expansion: Tutor uses expansion strength to bridge reversing expansion or asks a discriminating question.
Direct formula request does not force factoring remediation.
same-goal-symbol-roles: Tutor retains factoring strength and selects coefficient-versus-unknown clarification or a discriminating question.
Compare actual teaching with reverse-expansion case; same broad goal does not force same diagnosis.
correct-tutor-reference: Private reference: x=3 is correct; x=7 fails substitution.
If tutor initially misjudges, learner challenge causes correction from original work without another competence test.
If tutor catches the bad key immediately, record successful prevention and mark review-flag repair branch NOT_RUN rather than inventing an error.
Current summary/review state and next conversation do not retain a false algebra deficit.
small-directory-missed-query: Inspect actual query overlap; do not assume zero overlap from scenario label.
If directory is genuinely complete, tutor can inspect the recipe-slot description as a possible connection.
Tutor may ask a discriminating question rather than assert equivalence.
Attribute recovery to delivered directory cards when lexical search did not match.
large-directory-recovery: Driver seeds clearly marked retrieval-only records through actual tools; this is not tutor-authored memory evidence.
Confirm actual directory byte pressure before claiming focused mode; never fabricate a missing match.
Record first query and results, then actual browse/original-work reads if recovery occurs.
If tutor does not browse or no missing-query condition occurs, record that branch honestly; do not silently guide it with hidden diagnosis.
current-evidence-overrides-history: Current factoring demonstrations qualify the historical difficulty.
Tutor revises the relevant current memory and addresses sign handling rather than defending the old diagnosis.
Fresh work and old history remain inspectable with distinct occurrence/help metadata.
natural-assisted-unconventional: Question and self-report may inform qualified memory without registered tasks.
Division-first linear solution is valid; do not require the expected method.
Assisted b=-7 response is visibly attributed to actual prior help and not independent performance.
slip-versus-repetition: One self-corrected sign-copy error is not promoted to a broad repeated symbol-role misconception.
Compare description and teaching with Tuesday repeated confusion; do not require a numerical mastery score.
controls-and-pending-failure: Direct answer/stop/recording control is honored even with a pending task.
No subsequent learner text, checkpoint, notes or context trace is persisted after recording_off.
If supported orchestration can induce one transient semantic-write failure, original native capture remains pending and useful teaching continues. If not, mark failure branch NOT_RUN.
Durable-control failure must report local stop and precise restart limitation; never claim durable success.
